mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS implementation, for both TLS termination and client connections, chosen for its cleaner implementation and memory-safe design. TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development and production alike.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
